subject: Scallion Health — pricing recap & invoice estimate
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari@scallionhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Scallion Health — post-demo pricing recap / next steps

Hi Ari,

Thanks again for your time on today's demo — appreciate the honest line on volumes and constraints. Quick recap from my side and a proposed next step to lock down a draft estimate for procurement: 

- Ask: Scallion will ingest clinical notes + patient messaging for a pilot across 3 products (triage bot, note synthesis, and inbox assistant).
- Expected monthly tokens (Q4 pilot): starting band 100k-300k tokens/month; expected scale to 4-6M tokens/month if pilot succeeds.
- Performance target: average 95th pctl latency under 350ms for interactive flows.
- Budget band: internal you called out a target of roughly $6k–$8k/month for pilot (you flagged $/1M token approx target $700), with a longer-term target to get unit cost below $450/1M tokens at scale.

Next steps I propose: I will put together an invoice-style estimate (line-itemed) showing: unit cost scenarios at 100k / 1M / 5M monthly token volumes, recommended model/quantization options, and an expected monthly invoice range plus one-time setup fees. I will include a simple token-breakdown CSV so your engineers can sanity-check the volumes.

Deliverable timeline: updated estimate + attachments tomorrow EOD PT. Can you confirm procurement contact to CC on the invoice?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: none on initial note

From: Ari Patel <ari@scallionhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@scallionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scallion Health — post-demo pricing recap / next steps

Thanks Jasmine — this is great, and that timeline works. A few clarifications from my side: 

- The 100k-300k is our conservative pilot estimate. If we go to full pilot scope, realistic near-term is 2–5M tokens/mo for combined features (triage + notes).
- The $700/1M target was what our VP product suggested as a ceiling for pilot. We'd be happy with a $500–$600/1M at 2–5M token run-rate.
- Procurement contact is Sarah Lin (sarah.lin@scallionhealth.com) — please CC her on the invoice/estimate and the MLP/contract docs.

Also looping in procurement for any SSO/KMS requirements.

—Ari
Ari Patel
Head of Product
Scallion Health
ari@scallionhealth.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari@scallionhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@scallionhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scallion Health — post-demo pricing recap / next steps

Sarah / Ari — thanks for the confirmation. Attached are: 1) scallion-invoice-estimate-v2.xlsx (line-item invoice with monthly scenarios), 2) token-breakdown-100k-to-10m.csv (simple mapping of feature -> tokens/session -> projected monthly tokens), and 3) mutual-action-plan-sc-001.docx (proposal for pilot milestones + deliverables).

Key highlights from the estimate (summary):
- Pilot (100k–300k tokens/mo): est. monthly invoice $85–$240 (hosted tier + per-token); note this uses smaller model variant for cost-savings on low volume.
- Pilot scaled run-rate (2–5M tokens/mo): est. $1,000–$3,250/month depending on batching and quantization profile.
- Enterprise steady-state (5–10M tokens/mo) with reserved capacity / Dedicated: est. $2,700–$6,000/month; includes optional caching/KV savings (we show potential 20–35% token reduction).
- Unit economics summary: list shows $/1M token unit under three configurations: hosted small model $950, hosted optimized $700, dedicated quantized $420.
- One-time setup: $5,000 (integration + compliance checklist support), optional SOC2 evidence bundle + audit support priced separately.

Notes on assumptions (see spreadsheet tab "assumptions"): average tokens per triage session 1,200; notes synthesis 6,500 per patient record; concurrency assumptions for latency SLO.

Marcus — Monica, can you validate the Dedicated pricing line (quantized GPU profile) and confirm a short note we can include for procurement about SLA / billing cadence? If you have a recommended PO language, paste in and I will fold into the mutual-action-plan docx.

Attachments (stubs):
- scallion-invoice-estimate-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)
- token-breakdown-100k-to-10m.csv (csv, 12KB)
- mutual-action-plan-sc-001.docx (docx, 38KB)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@scallionhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ari Patel <ari@scallionhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scallion Health — post-demo pricing recap / next steps

Jasmine / team — received, thanks for the clear breakdown. A couple quick items from procurement: 

1) The PO timeline — we aim to complete internal approvals by 10/18 and would expect to issue an initial PO for the pilot the week of 10/19 if everything checks out.
2) Please add a short clause on data residency (US-only) and encryption-at-rest KMS acceptance into the mutual action plan.
3) For the invoice, please provide a monthly line for "pilot discount" so we can see pre-discount and post-discount values.

If you can make those updates, we can move to a formal purchase order. Sarah will be the signature authority on the PO.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Senior Manager, Procurement
Scallion Health
procurement@scallionhealth.com
